title: Show HN: Huzzah – Novel AI Coding Approach
description: New method for programming with AI assistance. Community discussion with 196 points and 110 comments.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Stop Anthropomorphizing Intermediate Tokens
description: Paper argues against interpreting middle tokens as reasoning. 189 points, 105 comments on Hacker News.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Vomit: Cleaning Claude 5 Token Output
description: Uses separate LLM to refine another model's output. 169 points, 184 comments discussing the technique.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Every Model Cheats
description: Research on prompt-level mitigation of model cheating behaviors. 75 points, 56 comments discussing the findings.
author: Hacker News Community

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
description: New arXiv publication on diffusion models. 130 points, 34 comments on Hacker News.
author: Hacker News Community

title: A Jagged Frontier: Evaluating Robustness of Code Agents to Semantics-Preserving Transformations
description: Evaluates code agents against transformations that preserve semantics. Authors from Colorado State University, Microsoft, UIUC, and Carnegie Mellon.
author: Researchers from CSU, Microsoft, UIUC, CMU

title: Adversarial Review: Structured Disagreement for Grounded Agentic Code Review
description: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on DL4C. Focuses on automated code review methodologies using structured disagreement.
author: Researchers

title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
description: Examines how looped architectures enhance tool use capabilities, relevant for code generation and function calling.
author: Researchers

title: SESSE: LLM-as-Judge Evaluation via Structured Decomposition
description: Framework for improving LLM evaluation through decomposition: Sketch, Expand, Sort, Summarize, Evaluate.
author: Researchers

title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
description: 62-page paper on coordinating multiple agents, combining AI with number theory applications.
author: Researchers

title: ComponentBench: Diagnosing Component-Level Failures in Computer-Use Agents
description: Accepted at COLM 2026. Benchmark for testing agent components at the component level.
author: Researchers

title: Qwen 3.8 27B matches GPT-5.6 Luna performance
description: Qwen 3.8 27B stands out as an impressive Apache 2-licensed 27B model that scores 52 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index—matching GPT-5.6 Luna. However, it tends toward 'wildly overthinking' things by default.
author: Simon Willison

title: ChatGPT Search site: operator usage surge
description: ChatGPT Search now uses the site: operator at scale. Promptwatch data shows usage jumped from 0.3-0.5% to 16-17% around August 8, correlating with GPT-5.6 Sol rollout.
author: Simon Willison

title: LLM tag hallucination strategy for classification
description: Doug Turnbull suggests 'Don't classify. Hallucinate!' — have LLMs invent tags, then use vector embeddings to find closest matches in your actual tag vocabulary.
author: Simon Willison (citing Doug Turnbull)

title: Encrypted reasoning traces security vulnerability
description: Research revealed encrypted reasoning traces from proprietary APIs could be extracted by replaying them into weaker model family members. Researchers found that 'every model under the same family used the same encryption key.'
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Code auto mode blocks 89% of harmful actions
description: Anthropic claims Claude Code's auto mode blocked 89% of harmful actions in testing, catching significantly more than human reviewers (13.6%). Simon remains cautious about prompt injection risks.
author: Simon Willison

title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 released with 1.7T parameters
description: DeepSeek released V4 Pro 0813 (1.7T parameters), showing markedly different outputs across reasoning levels.
author: Simon Willison

title: Meta Muse Glimmer: 30B Apache 2 model for agents
description: Meta introduced Muse Glimmer, a 30B Apache 2 model optimized for agentic workflows.
author: Simon Willison

title: cors-chat and alchemy-utils tools released
description: Simon built cors-chat to test local models like Qwen 3.8 and alchemy-utils as a database-agnostic alternative to sqlite-utils using SQLAlchemy. The latter can import SF's tree dataset into DuckDB in 35 seconds.
author: Simon Willison

title: Bun 1.4 adds Bun.WebView for browser automation
description: Bun 1.4 adds Bun.WebView for browser automation, with Simon prototyping a web API that loads pages and executes JavaScript.
author: Simon Willison
